approval.evidence: The v2 validation run (2026-08-21, authorization 7734b745, request sha256 29c55d0b) failed one of five predeclared gates: determinate specificity 13/15 = 0.867 against 0.90, with both misses being reference-label versus judge cue readings. The user rejected closing the arc and approved a v3 iteration with the message 'I'm not sure I'm ready to write off this whole arc on a single fail, 13/15 vs 14/15. So I want to run v3, just not quite so pessimistically' (2026-08-21). Agreed terms: the instrument, prompts, output schema, derivation rules, and all five gates are unchanged; v3 changes only the corpus (54 fresh cases, fresh worlds, spent v1/v2 corpora permanently excluded, every reference label confirmed by a blind claude-sonnet-5 second reader with the one disagreement dropped) and the sample size (specificity denominator 39). That build merged to main as PR #762 (merge commit 734982ba) after independent Codex review returned APPROVE with no defects. A gate failure is categorical (no retry, no rescore) but does not close the arc; any v4 needs a fresh corpus, a written diagnosis, and separate explicit human approval. The 36-dialogue confirmation stays on HOLD; this authorization grants only the bounded validation calls.
